name: io.github.guyko/midimcp
description: A local MCP server that manages MIDI guitar pedal execution. Provides persistent knowledge of pedal parameters and executes MIDI CC commands generated by AI assistants. Supports Meris LVX Delay, Mercury X Reverb, Enzo X Synthesizer, and Neural DSP Quad Cortex with complete preset creation capabilities.

tools.name: add_pedal
tools.description: Add new guitar pedals with MIDI CC mappings

tools.name: get_pedal
tools.description: Retrieve specific pedal information and CC mappings

tools.name: list_pedals
tools.description: List all available pedals and their capabilities

tools.name: execute_midi_command
tools.description: Execute a single MIDI CC command on a pedal

tools.name: execute_midi_commands
tools.description: Execute multiple MIDI CC commands in sequence to create presets

tools.name: execute_program_change
tools.description: Switch pedal presets via MIDI program change

tools.name: send_sysex
tools.description: Send sysex data directly to a MIDI device for preset uploads
